business_summary: Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides environmental services in China and internationally. It operates through eight segments: Industrial Waste Resource Utilization; Industrial Waste Treatment and Disposal; Rare and Precious Metal Recycling; Municipal Waste Treatment and Disposal, Renewable Energy Utilization; Environmental Engineering and Services; Electronic Waste Dismantling; and Others. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited and changed its name to Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited in December 2010. Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited was founded in 1999 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 환경 서비스를 제공합니다. 이는 8개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다: 산업 폐기물 자원 활용; 산업 폐기물 처리 및 폐기; 희귀 및 귀금속 재활용; 도시 폐기물 처리 및 처리, 재생 에너지 활용; 환경 엔지니어링 및 서비스; 전자 폐기물 해체; 및 기타. 회사는 이전에 Shenzhen Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited로 알려졌으나 2010년 12월에 Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Dongjiang Environmental Company Limited는 1999년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
